extracted.name: Grandma’s Cranberry-Orange Gelatin Salad
extracted.description: A classic cranberry-pineapple gelatin salad expected on everyone’s Thanksgiving menu, this version adds a flavor twist with orange zest and pecans.
ingredient_lines: 1 (6 ounce) package raspberry flavored Jell-O® mix
1 (16 ounce) can whole berry cranberry sauce
instruction_lines: Place gelatin into a bowl, pour in boiling water, and stir until gelatin dissolves. Mix in cranberry sauce, pineapple, celery, pecans, and orange zest until evenly blended.
Pour gelatin mixture into a mold or serving dish. Chill in the refrigerator for 8 hours to overnight.
To make topping, beat cream cheese with 1/2 of the whipped topping. Fold in remaining whipped topping until well blended.
Unmold gelatin, then spread with topping mixture.
